messages.content: Who was responsible for your instruction when you joined the community?
Mara was my teacher. She could make an ordinary mistake very difficult to hide from.
Are you able to visit that person these days?
I cannot see Mara. She died some years ago. I still remember her, but remembering is not another conversation with her.
